text: Cucumbers are typically ready to harvest from about 35 days after transplanting and can be picked repeatedly every 1-2 days over a 25-35 day harvest window, yielding roughly 3-5 kg per m² over the cycle. Fruit is picked in the morning when firmness/moisture content is highest, sorted into grade 1 and grade 2 by size/appearance, and packed in ventilated containers (not sealed plastic bags without holes) to avoid heat buildup and bruising during transport.
